licence.name: GPL-3.0-only
licence.source: The repository LICENSE is the GPLv3 text and the list header points to it, with no "or later", so CPAB treats the list as GPL-3.0-only. The same text ships as LICENSE at the top of the package.

checks.licenceStated: The list header "License:" points to https://github.com/hagezi/dns-blocklists/blob/main/LICENSE. That file was read on 2026-11-07: it is the GPLv3 text, byte-identical to CPAB's own LICENSE.
checks.licenceAccepted: GPL-3.0 is on the accepted set, only or later.
checks.notRefused: No NonCommercial or NoDerivatives term, nothing forbids redistribution or restricts the audience.
checks.attribution: HaGeZi (https://github.com/hagezi/dns-blocklists), shown in settings and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md.
checks.aggregated: An aggregate. Its inputs are listed in sources.md at commit acded31b209c342f06c38af538281c7ed306202e, and FAQ section 11 says none is copied one to one: HaGeZi rewrites them. 21 inputs were spot-checked on 2026-11-07, all on the accepted set (GPL-3.0, MIT, MPL-2.0, Unlicense, CC0, CC BY-SA 4.0, CC BY 4.0, CC BY 3.0, AGPL-3.0). Not verified: cbuijs/ut1, DandelionSprout/adfilt, pgl.yoyo.org, big.oisd.nl, two Codeberg inputs and about 150 regional ones. One input is the Codeberg copy of PersianBlocker: CPAB doesn't copy that file, and the owner accepted the list with it (PRD D21). Care: read sources.md again at each snapshot.
checks.ownFile: The converted rules are one file of their own, never merged with another list, under GPL-3.0-only. The GPLv3 text is in the package as LICENSE.
checks.retrievable: A stable repository. The snapshot is fetched at the last commit that changed adblock/light.txt and records that commit, the list's own Version line and its SHA-256.
